description: This Java class implements the PortfolioAccountReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve account data (savings and loan accounts) from a database, including specific account details, collections for lookup, and accounts paid in advance. It uses JDBC templates and row mappers for database interactions.

classes.name: PortfolioSavingsAccountMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping savings account database rows to PortfolioAccountData objects.

classes.name: PortfolioLoanAccountMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping loan account database rows to PortfolioAccountData objects.

classes.name: PortfolioLoanAccountRefundByTransferMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping loan accounts with refund by transfer details to PortfolioAccountData objects, including custom SQL for calculating total overpaid.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single account by ID and type, optionally filtered by currency code.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of accounts based on criteria in PortfolioAccountDTO for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveOneByPaidInAdvance
methods.description: Retrieves a loan account paid in advance by account ID.
